job.title: Country Lead - GTM Recruiter - Technology Sales Recruitment (APAC)
job.description:
We're partnering with an established global recruitment firm that specialises in go-to-market hiring (GTM) for technology companies. They're opening up Asia-Pacific for the first time, and they want a genuine GTM or Tech Sales Recruiter to be their first person on the ground.

Whether you've got a couple of years or a few more behind you, this is a chance to build a business from scratch with real support behind you.

What's on offer
  • First-hire status, so you shape how the APAC business is built.
  • A proven international business behind you, so you aren't starting from nothing.
  • Uncapped earning potential, so your results decide your income.
  • A clear path to grow into team leadership as the region scales.

The role
You'll own the APAC GTM desk, working with technology clients at every stage from early-stage scale-ups through to established vendors.

You'll be responsible for:
  • Running full-cycle recruitment for GTM roles across the region
  • Building and managing client relationships
  • Sourcing and engaging passive candidates
  • Developing new business
  • Helping shape the processes for the new APAC desk

About you
  • Agency recruitment experience in genuine GTM and tech sales hiring
  • At least 2 years recruiting in the Australian market
  • A strong track record of billing, with 2-4 years in GTM recruitment being ideal
  • Ambitious, commercial and comfortable working independently
  • Based in Australia (Sydney or Melbourne preferred)

If you're feeling like you've outgrown your current environment, we'd love to have a confidential chat.

Interested? This role is being managed by Sorciety. Hit apply or reach out to Lee at Sorciety on lee@sorciety.com for a confidential conversation. We specialise in rec2rec, so if this one isn't quite right, we'd still love to connect and keep you across what else is moving in the Australian recruitment market.

job.title: State Manager / Associate Director - Technology Recruitment
job.description:
Looking for your next step into leadership?

We're partnering with a specialist technology recruitment business that has grown consistently for more than a decade and built a respected name in its market. They're now looking for a State Manager / Associate Director to lead and grow their Melbourne office.

This is a player-manager role for a commercially sharp senior recruiter or manager who wants to build something, not just keep it ticking over.

What's on offer
  • $110k–$160k base + super + bonuses, with uncapped commission, so your earnings reflect what you bring in
  • A genuine path to equity through an employee share plan, rarely offered at this stage of a career
  • An established delivery team and client base already in place, so the work you win gets filled, not stuck on your desk
  • A respected specialist brand, so clients take your call from day one
  • National support across marketing, operations and contractor care, so you can focus on clients and your team
  • Individual and team incentives, generous leave, and flexible, outcome-focused hybrid working
  • A clear pathway for leadership and career progression, without having to step away from the market

The role
You'll own the Melbourne market: winning new business, leading the team and shaping the office's growth plan with the directors. You'll be responsible for:
  • Driving business development and bringing in new clients and roles
  • Leading, coaching and motivating the existing delivery team
  • Helping attract and hire experienced recruiters as the Melbourne office grows
  • Billing your own desk as a player-manager
  • Building the Melbourne strategy and, over time, owning the P&L
  • Representing the business across the Melbourne technology community

About you
  • A strong track record as a senior or principal consultant, team leader or manager in agency recruitment
  • Technology recruitment experience in any specialism
  • Experience leading, mentoring or developing recruiters
  • Genuinely commercial: you enjoy BD and know how to win work
  • Hungry, switched on and motivated by building a business, not just a desk

Most leadership roles take you away from the market. This one doesn't. You'll stay close to clients and candidates while building a team and shaping the Melbourne business. If you're ready to step up, we'd love to have a confidential chat.
